description: Install and manage apps: list (all: system apps too), state, install (path: .apk, .app, .ipa; files: an .apk with its .dm or split APKs), uninstall, stop (background: as the system ends it, state kept), clear (data), grant, revoke (service: location, photos…; a wrong word lists them), build_and_run (path: Xcode project or Gradle folder; scheme or module; configuration or variant; args, env). Starting one: launch_app; its data: transfer_files. Returns what was done.
name: manage_app
title: Manage apps
